T-001.Title: Introduce the session coordinator in search.rs and strip terminal ownership from both engine adapters

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add failing-first inline cfg(test) tests in src-tauri/src/m013b/search.rs that execute the production session path and fail against the current double-terminal tree: a two-root embedded trace collected to a quiet period (never truncated at the first terminal) shows both roots' matches before exactly one terminal, a strictly increasing session-wide seq with no restart at the root boundary and zero events after the terminal; the same invariants hold for one-root success, zero matches and batched results, for both engine adapters. Record the failing receipt before implementing.

Introduce SearchTerminal and SearchSessionCoordinator (session-wide strictly increasing seq starting at 1, one-shot finalize that cannot publish a second terminal and silences later matches) plus run_session as the single production finalization path used by the mt_search_spawn worker thread; run_search and run_ripgrep stop owning terminals and seq — they emit only match batches through the coordinator and return per-root results or errors, and all production roots pass through run_session. Keep command names, the mt::search-event channel, searchId, kind values, hits/error payload fields and wire types; keep M-010 root validation before registration, App Store and missing-rg engine selection, current options, batch/line bounds and ordinary root traversal order; keep query text, match contents and user paths out of any new diagnostic fields. Update the file-local MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP and CHANGE_SUMMARY and bump the module version.

A returned engine error from either adapter finalizes exactly one error event, never starts the remaining roots and is never followed by complete or matches; pre-start cancellation, mid-root cancellation, cancellation between roots, repeated cancellation and cancellation after completion produce at most one terminal and never revive a session; the worker thread removes the registry entry on every path and run_ripgrep kills and waits only its own rg child. Error injection uses the existing invalid-executable and bad-pattern seams; tests do not mutate process-global PATH and do not weaken existing budgets, timeouts or retries.

T-002.Title: Prove the two-root session through the actual renderer shim and searcher with renderer files read-only

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Extend tests/renderer/node/ripgrepSearcher-deep.test.js with the two-root embedded regression driven through the actual shim and the full renderer searcher over the new producer trace: both synthetic roots' files are collected, the thenable settles exactly once after the last root's results, unsubscribe happens once, and observable behavior matches the rg control; capture uses full-trace collection so a premature terminal cannot truncate the proof.

Keep every existing assertion in tests/renderer/ipc/runtime-search.test.ts and tests/renderer/store/search.test.ts unweakened and pin wire compatibility (searchId, kind values, hits/error/seq envelope) against the unchanged consumer in src/renderer/src/ipc/runtime/search.ts, which stays byte-for-byte read-only together with src/renderer/src/store/search.js and src/renderer/src/node/ripgrepSearcher.js; stale renderer generations still cannot overwrite results or running state and cancellation in one session cannot finish another.
